text: dsh-llmwiki 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的长期记忆插件，以本地 Markdown vault 保存每日会话记录和整理过的知识。它通过 memory_search 与 memory_save 工具供模型检索和保存内容，并可在每轮提示词组装前检索相关 wiki 知识注入上下文。主要功能包括关键词检索、沿 wikilink 扩展关联笔记、近期 chronicle 检索、按 token 预算整理上下文，以及自动记录对话。适合希望跨会话保留项目知识并使用本地 Markdown 笔记的人。无需 API key；默认使用本机 ~/llmwiki-vault。

dsh-llmwiki adds long-term memory to DSH Web using a local Markdown vault. The model can search and save notes, and relevant wiki content can be injected into prompts. Keyword, wikilink, and recent-log search support recall; conversations can be saved as daily notes. No API key is needed.
想让 DSH 记住之前会话里的决定和项目背景。
有没有办法把每轮对话自动存成本地 Markdown 日志？
让 DSH 从我的本地笔记里找出和当前问题相关的内容。
我希望模型能主动搜索并保存长期记忆。
能不能沿着笔记里的 wikilink 找到相关知识？
给提示词注入相关笔记时，怎么限制上下文占用？
I want my DSH sessions to remember useful decisions from earlier conversations.
Can DSH search my local Markdown notes and add relevant context automatically?
dsh-llmwiki 的功能「检索记忆」：模型调用 memory_search 并提供查询词，可选设置结果数；插件搜索本地 wiki，返回标题、路径、片段、分数和检索策略。
dsh-llmwiki 的功能「保存洞见」：模型调用 memory_save，提交分类、标题和 Markdown 内容；插件将洞见追加到当天的 chronicle 日志，并清空检索缓存。
dsh-llmwiki 的功能「自动注入上下文」：收到用户输入时检索本地 wiki，并在本轮提示词组装时提供相关内容；可通过 autoInject 配置关闭。
dsh-llmwiki 的功能「记录会话」：每轮结束后将用户文本和助手回复追加到当天的 Markdown chronicle 文件，分别截取至 500 和 2000 字符；可通过 autoCapture 配置关闭。
dsh-llmwiki 的功能「多策略检索」：可组合关键词、wikilink 图关联和近期日志检索，并用 RRF 融合结果；检索策略、回溯天数和结果数量均可配置。
dsh-llmwiki 使用前须知：启用自动捕获后，用户消息和助手回复会写入本机 vault 的 chronicle/daily 日志；vault 默认位于 ~/llmwiki-vault。

dsh-llmwiki README · dsh-llmwiki：> **Context Window = RAM, Local Wiki = Disk** — long-term memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), powered by your local Markdown vault.

TypeScript port of [llmwiki](https://github.com/chancelu/llmwiki-harness) (Python: [`llmwiki-harness`](https://pypi.org/project/llmwiki-harness/) on PyPI), packaged as a native dsh plugin.

dsh-llmwiki README · What it does：| Mechanism | dsh extension point |
|---|---|
| Inject relevant wiki knowledge into the same turn's model request | `session/event` (`agent/inbox/spliced`, pre-assembly live event) → `ctx.systemPrompt.context()` |
| Teach the model about memory | `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` |
| `memory_search` — model recalls prior sessions / curated notes | `ctx.tools.register()` |
| `memory_save` — model persists durable insights | `ctx.tools.register()` |
| Auto-capture every turn to `chronicle/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md` | `session/event` (`turn/end`) |

dsh-llmwiki README · What it does：Retrieval: **keyword + wikilink graph + temporal** strategies fused with **RRF** (Reciprocal Rank Fusion), assembled under a **token budget**, with an **LRU + TTL cache**. Zero runtime dependencies beyond Node.js.

dsh-llmwiki README · Vault layout (created automatically)：```
my-vault/
├── raw/               # Layer 1: session dumps
├── chronicle/daily/   # Layer 2: auto-captured daily logs
├── entities/          # Layer 3: compiled knowledge

Open it with Obsidian, curate Layer-3 notes with `[[wikilinks]]` — the graph strategy follows them.

dsh-llmwiki README · Install：Requires **Node.js ≥ 22** (same as dsh itself) and a working `dsh` CLI (`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`) with `pnpm` on PATH.

```sh
dsh-llmwiki README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llmwiki
dsh-llmwiki README · or from a tarball：dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-llmwiki-0.1.1.tgz

dsh-llmwiki README · verify the layer, then boot：dsh --profile web --dump-config   # shows a "# == dsh-llmwiki" layer
dsh web                           # logs: [dsh-llmwiki] memory plugin loaded, vault: ...
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` activates it automatically — no manual patching needed.

dsh-llmwiki README · Configure：The plugin works zero-config (vault defaults to `~/llmwiki-vault`). To override, add a row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or a `--patch` overlay) — note the override restates the row by `id` **without** `insert`:

```yaml
- id: llmwiki
  config:
    vaultPath: /path/to/your/vault   # Obsidian vault welcome
    tokenBudget: 2000

A patch replaces the row's **entire** config, so restate every key you want to keep.

dsh-llmwiki README · Config：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `vaultPath` | `~/llmwiki-vault` | Markdown vault path; structure created if missing |
| `tokenBudget` | `2000` | Max tokens of injected wiki context |
| `strategies` | `[keyword, graph, temporal]` | Enabled recall strategies |
| `daysBack` | `7` | Temporal look-back window |
| `topK` | `5` | Results per retrieval |
| `priority` | `relevance` | Assembly priority: `relevance` / `recency` / `diversity` / `structured` |
| `cacheTtl` | `300` | Cache TTL seconds |
| `autoInject` | `true` | Inject wiki context on each user message |
| `autoCapture` | `true` | Append each turn to the daily chronicle |

dsh-llmwiki README · How the pieces map from the Python original：| Python (`llmwiki`) | TypeScript (`dsh-llmwiki`) |
|---|---|
| `core/retriever.py` | `src/retriever.ts` |
| `core/assembler.py` | `src/assembler.ts` |
| `core/cache.py` | `src/cache.ts` |
| `vault/capture.py` | `src/capture.ts` |
| `search/python_engine.py` | merged into `retriever.ts` (keeps the package zero-dep) |
| `OpenClawMemoryHook` adapter | the dsh plugin itself (`src/index.ts`) |
